summary: Enhance your skills with our Drinking Water Treatment and Safety Training Course. Learn essential techniques to ensure safe drinking water for all.
lede: Drinking water treatment combines source-risk assessment, process controls, testing, and distribution safeguards to protect water quality. For utility and facility staff, operators, public-health teams, and water-quality professionals, the course supports practical decisions about safe supply, including selecting treatment steps, checking disinfection and residuals, building monitoring plans, and responding to contamination incidents.
audienceIntro: This course is tailored for professionals who regularly make decisions on drinking water safety and treatment performance.
audience: Water and wastewater utility managers and supervisors
Public health officers and environmental health staff
WASH program managers and field coordinators (NGOs/humanitarian)
Facility managers for hotels, hospitals, schools
modules: Treatment Process Overview and Process Selection
Water Quality Testing and Monitoring Plans
Distribution System Safety and Recontamination Control
Water Safety Plans and Risk-Based Management
Incident Response and Emergency Water Safety
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of water treatment processes and safety concepts. Prior experience in water management or a related field is beneficial.
topics: Water & wastewater treatment and utility management
